source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing changes four form-picker assertions from the outer item's title attribute to the nested autocomplete-row-item label. Expected values and the later outer-item click stay unchanged. Each changed Assert.equal still lacks its message argument, so the four sites need a nonempty expected-result message under the current review guidance. The shared fixture and caller checks establish the intended source scenario; they do not verify Gecko's label getter, suggestion matching, native focus or intermittent-failure cause. No browser test was run.
title: The form-picker checks read the nested autocomplete row label
